meta.title: Signal Harbor: An Agent's Journey and the Way Out
meta.subtitle: Ideal state: one exit, four guards, and tools that run inside the company plane

boundaries.label: Company data plane: tools run here, nothing is reachable from outside

cards.title: What an agent's brain is
items: Its instructions, the context pack for its module, the tools it is allowed, and its memory. Nothing else
The context pack is assembled per question: industry pack, domain context, and the company's own context from inside its plane
One agent per module; it can only see tools and context for modules the company owns

cards.title: Three things can leave, each with a rule
items: A prompt to the model provider: minimised, names as tokens, checked, logged
A query to the internet: written in public terms only, to an allowlisted destination
A call to an outside tool: treated exactly like an internet query and sent through the same exit
There is no other path: tools inside the plane have no network access of their own

cards.title: Four guards, in order
items: 1 Internal tools return counts, totals and field names, never rows; a group smaller than five is not shown
2 The minimiser keeps only the fields the question needs
3 The pseudonymiser swaps company, people, fund and counterparty names for tokens; the vault stays inside and the reply is mapped back inside
4 The egress gateway allows only listed destinations, blocks any payload holding a vault name or a raw record, and logs every call

cards.title: Asking the internet without telling it anything
items: The agent never forwards the user's question. It writes a new query in public terms, such as a market, an asset class or a regulation
What comes back is marked as outside material: context for the answer, never an instruction and never a source of the company's own figures
Internet access is a switch per company and per module; off means the agent answers from the plane and the pack only

cards.title: For the strictest client
items: A private model running inside the client's own cloud, so no prompt leaves at all
Internet off, outside tools off, typing only
The same modules and agents; only the egress settings change

cards.title: Built today, not yet, and the honest limit
items: Built: one model gateway, a read-only tool loop, the under-five rule, a classifier on remote writes, company isolation, numbers traced to facts
Not built: the pseudonymiser and vault, the public-query writer, the destination allowlist, the MCP tool registry, the per-company internet switch
Limit: unless the model is private, a prompt does go to a provider. Tokens and minimising reduce what it contains; a no-retention contract covers the rest
